revision_summary: Primary fix needed: cherry_pick_moments entry at ts 01:38 misattributes 'Oh, who does it? Who does it?' to the customer when the transcript shows the REP speaking both this line and the follow-up 'I have no idea' — there is no customer question here to fail to answer. Correct the speaker attribution and reframe the coaching point as the rep rhetorically raising a question he has no answer to, rather than the rep failing to respond to a customer ask. Relatedly, state_changes entry at ts 01:22 ('Oh, it's an apartment?') is also the rep's line, not a customer state marker — either remove it from state_changes or reclassify as a rep-side reaction, not customer trajectory. Secondary fixes: (1) the empathy_on_vulnerability_disclosure schema citation at 02:11 should be dropped or replaced — this moment doesn't fit the schema's defined vulnerability categories (health/financial/family/scam); reframe under setter_scope_discipline or general professionalism instead. (2) The button_up.is_that_fair_handshake citation at 02:26 is a category mismatch since this call never reaches button_up (no appointment); remove or replace with a non-schema-anchored professionalism note. (3) Consider adding the stronger, independent DQ-confirmation line at 01:48 ('also a rental house') to grounded_examples/cherry_pick as the cleanest textual anchor for the not_homeowner DQ. (4) Soften 'functionally zero value' framing in trajectory_verdict.summary to avoid tone overcalibration.
